question: Are the stream endpoints POST routes taking the same JSON body as their twins (consumed with a streaming fetch), or GET routes taking the inputs as query parameters so the browser's EventSource API can use them?
readings: POST with the same JSON body as the non-streaming endpoints; the client reads the stream with fetch.
GET with url/data, include_tags and include_categories as query parameters, so EventSource can subscribe.
upstream: POST routes with the same request body models as the non-streaming endpoints.
rationale: EventSource only supports GET, so an engineer adding SSE endpoints for a browser page has to choose between the native API with query parameters and a POST body read through fetch; the request names the inputs and the paths but not the method. All four target tests POST a JSON body to the stream routes.
